claim: An archive POKE's name can be wrong: read what it writes, in the code page in play, before accepting or rejecting it; the saved bank at 0xC000 may not be the one the game runs.
limit: Shown for one POKE of one game; the bank rule applies to any 128K snapshot saved with another bank paged at 0xC000.

evidence.text: Easy steering 62869-72 was rejected as writing ROM by decoding it against the saved bank at 0xC000; in the code page in play (bank 0) it is code that blanks the dashboard steering-wheel marker only: display, misnamed. Real steering is 0x96AC.
evidence.quote: an archive POKE's name can be wrong
